notes.title: Bug fixes & Minor Tweaks
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that prevented the players to obtain some steam achivements.
- There was a rifle in front of te stores that has been removed.
- Some framed badges could not be obtained correctly.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused you to not be able to interact with NPCs

notes.title: Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator V1.1.2 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
CHANGES:

 Now you can rotare furniture freely instead of the fixed 90-angle rotation.
 Now you can use the bed earlier in the day.
 The localization has been updated to include all the new items and descriptions of the last updates.
 Fixed a bug that prevented you from storing items quickly by pressing shift + click when using a refrigerator.
 Fixed a bug that changed the FOV setting to 90 when you pressed RMB using the shotgun.
 Fixed a bug that prevented some configuration settings to not be saved between play sessions.

notes.title: Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator V1.1.1 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
CHANGES:

 A clock has been added in the player's hud.
 The 'Materials' section has been added to the store. Here you can buy building materials instead of collecting them.
 Glass has been added as a new construction material. As this is a material that cannot be collected in the forest, players will have to acquire it in the new 'Materials' section of the store.
 New glass building pieces have been added, both walls and roofs of different sizes and shapes.
 The lighting of the lamps has been revised.
 Fixed a bug where the chests were covered with snow even if they were indoors.

notes.title: Evergreen v1.1.0 | Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a rendering bug that affected some foliage pieces using DX11.

notes.title: Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator V1.1.0 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
In this update we have focused on addressing some technical issues in the game and adding quality of life features for players.

The save system has been rebuilt from scratch. With the new saving system the game now has support for multiple save files and Steam Cloud Saving.

CHANGES:

 Fixed a bug where you would fall into the void if you pressed the continue game button without having any save file on your computer.
 You can now have up to 5 save slots. Each one with a different game state.
 Steam Cloud game saving support has been added.
 Now when you try to loot an animal with a full inventory it will show a message on the screen.
 Fixed a bug where some parts of the ceiling could not be painted.
 Dirt paths have been cleared of trees that were making driving uncomfortable


Thank you very much to all of you who have taken the time to leave your feedback on the game. I want you to know that, even if we can't reply to all the players, everything you write to us is read and taken into consideration.

The next update will be focused on adding more content, especially on expanding the construction system with new pieces.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator V1.0.2 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
CHANGES:

 Now you can paint the walls with different colors on each side.
 Now you can use the brush to remove the paint from a wall. To do so, use the brush without paint.
 Four more roof pieces have been added.
 A fireplace has been added in the store.
 Fixed a bug where the forest ambient sound was muted.

notes.title: Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator V1.0.1 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello players!

Thank you very much to all of you who have bought the game and have taken the time to leave your feedback.

CHANGES:

 The difficulty of the 'Gamer' badges have been adjusted.
 Visibility at night has been increased.
 Minor adjustments to the menus and interfaces.
The possibility to disable the hunger system has been added. To activate it go to Options > Gameplay > Disable hunger system.
